summary: std::function is a general-purpose polymorphic function wrapper. It can store, copy, and invoke any CopyConstructible callable target: functions, lambdas, bind expressions, function objects, and member function pointers.
cpp17_notes: C++17 deprecates result_type, argument_type, first_argument_type, second_argument_type aliases (removed in C++20). C++23 adds move_only_function for move-only callables. C++26 adds copyable_function and function_ref.
audio_thread_notes: std::function MUST NOT be used on the audio thread. Assignment and construction may allocate heap memory due to type erasure. Use templates, raw function pointers, or std::atomic<T*> for callback passing. If a callback must be stored, assign during initialization.
